    SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(LOWER(Admission)) LIKE 'out%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient
  FROM Patient
  WHERE TRIM(UPPER(SEX)) IN ('M', 'MALE')
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN inpatient > outpatient THEN 'in-patient'
    WHEN outpatient > inpatient THEN 'outpatient'
